claim: When a scanner dedupes or resurfaces findings by counting evidence refs, key quoted code evidence on path plus normalized quote and keep the line only as a hint, because a line-number key turns every unrelated edit above the quote into new evidence.
because: dowser WP1b: with UNIQUE(fp,type,path:line) a 2-line shift counted as a new ref and would un-snooze a snoozed item; re-keyed and covered by evidence-keys.test.mjs.

claim: When the owning store has no multi-statement transactions, stamp the decision on the item row with a compare-and-set and rebuild the append-only verdict log from those stamps before each read, so verdict write-back still lands exactly once.
because: Forge SQL accepts one statement per request; the Dowser inbox accept/verdict path was rebuilt on CAS moves, CAS counters, decision stamps and repairVerdicts, tested on node:sqlite.

claim: When an entry point self-heals a missing schema by catching the error, classify the error from the driver structured cause fields (error code / errno / debug payload), not from the message text, because hosted SQL clients wrap the cause in a generic message.
because: Forge SQL threw Unknown SQL execution error with ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE only in context.debug; the message-regex check never fired live (it passed on node:sqlite), so a minor deploy answered unavailable until the daily migrate. Fixed in 583dc99, verified on the live site.

claim: When an agent eval scores a system that emits at most N items, seed more than N expected findings with priorities plus decoys, because a fixture with N or fewer findings lets every competent run score 1.0 and the eval cannot fail.
because: Dowser lens baselines at 0.1.0 scored recall and precision 1.0 on three of four lenses with a 4-card budget and 3-4 seeded findings; after seeding 6 per lens with priorities, decoys and a direction case, 0.1.0 vs 0.2.0 separated (opportunity recall-at-budget 0.75 to 1.0) and hand checks surfaced scorer-granularity and label errors.

claim: When a wire contract names an optional field, assert it in one seam test that runs both sides' real code, because each side's own tests pass while a writer's field allowlist silently drops it.
because: Dowser's outbox RECORD_KEYS omitted artifacts for days; skill tests checked what was sent, Forge tests what it did with views it received; the added local-forge seam assertion failed without the fix and passed with it.

claim: When a quality gate counts functions over a length threshold, record the longest function beside the count, because splitting one very long function into several medium ones raises the count while removing the real risk.
because: Splitting a 418-line React component into hooks moved functions-over-60 from 12 to 15 while the longest fell from 418 to 114; the count alone read as a regression.
